name: Alvin Smith
dateNote: He died on 19 November 1823, years before the Church was organized; section 137 is dated 21 January 1836.
importance: Alvin Smith was the eldest son of the Smith family; he worked to pay for their farm and oversaw building their Manchester home. He died in 1823 after a severe stomach illness, before the Church existed. In section 137 Joseph reports seeing Alvin in the celestial kingdom and wondering how, since Alvin was never baptized. The revelation answers that those who would have received the gospel will be heirs of that kingdom.
connections: He was the son of Joseph Smith Sr. and Lucy Mack Smith and older brother of Hyrum and Joseph Smith.

sources.title: Alvin Smith, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and family checked on JSP; death date read from a cut fragment. JSP footnote suggests appendicitis complicated by calomel, so the profile says only “severe stomach illness.”
